title: backend-skeleton cross-feature impact graph
description: Validates the return shape of lib/impact-graph.mjs's buildImpactGraph(root) and `bskel impact export --format json`'s output. D-cross-feature-impact-graph. Every node id is an already-persisted exact identity (a feature id, a contract operation key, a scan-report resourceType, a table name, or a declared dependency field) -- there is no inferred/guessed node. Every edge carries `basis` (which artifact, and its sha256, proves this edge exists) and `confidence` ('proven'|'heuristic') so a consumer can tell a name-identity match backed by an explicit @Table/@Column from one backed by an adapter's guessed fallback. Deliberately no `calls` relation and no third confidence value -- service-to-service/dynamic-client inference is out of scope (see DECISIONS.md's EXIT list), and a missing edge is honest while a guessed one is not.

file.description: Repo-relative source file, when this node resolves to one (resource/field).

attrs.description: Type-specific extra facts (verb/path for operation, table/tableSource for resource, etc.) -- open, since node types genuinely carry different metadata.

artifact.description: Repo-relative path to the persisted file this edge was read from.

locator.description: Where inside the artifact, e.g. a JSON pointer or field name -- human-navigable, not machine-parsed.
